metadata.datasource: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Fujifilm KB-111E3 density records with C1 interpolation. The first and last 12 points of each record provide monotonic extrapolation outside the published range. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer documents and developed-film photographs in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md.
